capture_mode: deterministic hidden in-app replay through canvas_input
cursor_cue: A synthetic pointer ring is labeled DRAW while drawing, SELECT while editing, and ORBIT during camera navigation; persistent text discloses synthetic input and no pressure data.

encoding.gif: Accelerated six-second preview of the same 60 replay checkpoints; plays once without a loop extension. Use the captioned MP4 master for normal-speed instruction.
encoding.mp4: Captured full-viewport RGBA frames; Blender H.264 fallback; 10 fps; repeated frame holds preserve the 18s duration.
encoding.poster: Selected full-resolution action frame encoded as PNG.

input_note: Synthetic PenSample input uses pressure=None and no tilt. The app applies its fixed default mouse-like width; no tablet pressure or latency was measured.
license_or_provenance: Original Japanese garden-house scene built into Sketch3D; the detail stroke and camera orbit are created during capture.

poster.alt: Selected cyan detail stroke and move gizmo in open canvas above the garden-house.

outputs.gif_preview: Accelerated 6-second preview; use the MP4 and timed VTT for normal-speed playback.

review.notes: Synthetic 18-second overview replay. Reviewed GIF key frames at 0/10/20/30/40/50, checked selected full-resolution posters, compared all VTT cues with action checkpoints, and validated VTT order/duration. Confirmed GIFs have no loop extension and scanned manifests/media for private paths. Full native-resolution motion/readability and rendered README-surface review remain pending.

shot_steps: Draw a detail, select and move it, then undo and redo the transform.
